title: X-energy
summary: US developer of high-temperature gas-cooled pebble-bed reactors.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

X-energy designs the Xe-100 high-temperature gas-cooled reactor and TRISO fuel, targeting industrial heat and power customers. It has government and industrial backing and is developing a fuel fabrication facility in Tennessee. Licensing and first-project economics determine progress.

Technology Exposure

  • High-temperature gas-cooled reactors
  • TRISO fuel fabrication
  • Industrial heat and power projects

What To Watch

  • NRC licensing
  • Fuel plant construction
  • First customer project

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
